reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser viewport review, not independent expert, official-board, physical-device, printer or calibration certification. Chosen25°C capacity0.36g/g, prescribed10s dose and0.1s transport delay, phenomenological first-order relaxation. Static-equivalent balance indication excludes transient impact/stirring/sensor forces. Tare150g includes apparatus/trapped air. Reference water/salt density0.997/2.165g/cm³ and dissolved partialvolume0.28cm³/g are drawing assumptions, not measured solution-volume calibration. Weighted transit clusters and enlarged ions are representative. No thermal,ballistic,evaporation,spillage,adsorption,chemical-reaction,noise orair-buoyancy model. Global camera/containment followups remain recorded for older labs.
